name: Stage 13:2: Nykvarn to Etapp 13
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 13:2, Nykvarn to Etapp 13.
utilities: Nykvarn station/centrum is the official access cluster, with the stage board about 100 m west of the railway station at Maskinförarvägen/Holländarvägen. Nykvarn has rail/bus access plus town services before the low-service connector begins.

Official parking options are Nykvarn centrum, Jägarskogens naturreservat, and Sandtorpsbadet. Nykvarn kommun lists several station-area/central parking options, but also says there is no municipal long-term parking; check signs and avoid assuming multi-day parking.
SL bus 780/780X serves the Södertälje-Nykvarn/Sandtorp corridor, but schedules and deviations should be checked live rather than hardcoded. The Djupsjön end still has poor direct public transport.
Nykvarn-area resupply and lodging are start-side only: ICA/centrum services are close to the stage board, while Turinge Hotel and Vidbynäs are off-route lodging options north/east of the start.

No verified public toilet was found at Nykvarn station or Sandtorpsbadet. Use Nykvarn town services before starting; the nearest mapped toilets are at Djupsjön near the connector end, and those should be treated as Stage 13/end-area context.
The Djupsjön/Stage 13 end has poor direct public transport. For transit-based trips, continue via the 13:1 Gnesta connector or arrange pickup rather than assuming a bus stop at the junction.
waterSources: Källsvik 30 has the strongest refill: an official year-round tap outside the carport. It is trail-listed but private-property-adjacent; be quiet, use only the listed tap, and do not camp, cook, wash, leave trash, block driveways, or enter yards/buildings.

The spring north of Djupsjön is an official natural source about 800 m north of Djupsjön; treat/filter and field-check flow. Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water access or quality, and dry-period source reports exist nearby.

Yngern, Gullsmorasjön, and Djupsjön are natural lake water only. Yngern is often described as very clean and Nykvarn planning material supports high water-quality context, but none of the lakes are verified potable refill points.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 17 km; Naturkartan agrees, while GPS/third-party traces commonly show about 15.8-16.6 km and the local map geometry measures about 16.6 km. Keep official distance for planning, with a drawn-distance caveat around 16 km.

OpenStreetMap relation 7604344 is useful context but is explicitly tagged 'Leden 13:2 ej komplett', has inconsistent distance metadata, measures around 16.1 km, and appears to start about 0.5 km short of the official Nykvarn start. Do not use it as the sole route authority; preserve the official start coordinate and branch status.
The connector opened in September 2017 and links Nykvarn into the Sörmlandsleden system at Djupsjön, where 13:2 and 13:1 meet the main stage 13 planning area.

Route character: town start, old forest toward northern Yngern, Sandtorpsbadet, Vargberget views, more road/gravel than the official prose makes obvious, then Sjöslingan along Yngern toward the Yngern/Gullsmorasjön passage.

Official suitable tent places are Sandtorpsbadet and Anderså. Sandtorpsbadet should be shown as an official trail-suggested tent/bathing area with local-sign verification required, because Nykvarn local order rules generally ban camping on bathing places except where specifically arranged/permitted.
Jägarskogen reserve forbids tenting, caravans/campers, damaging dead or living wood, and allows fires only at prepared places; do not treat the reserve shelter or firepit as camping permission.

Nykvarn local guidance warns of grill restrictions at municipal bathing places; do not show Sandtorpsbadet as a fire site unless a specific prepared fireplace is verified and current fire rules allow use. Outdoor fire remains the visitor's responsibility even at prepared places.

Yngern fishing requires appropriate permit coverage; do not imply free fishing. Gullsmorasjön fishing rights were not verified in this pass, so hikers should check local fishing rights before fishing.

Official page reported no fault reports at the time of research. Main planning risks are sparse guaranteed services after Nykvarn, road/gravel-road segments after Vargberget and around Herrvik/Källsvik, early wayfinding around Nykvarn/Jägarskogen, wet roots/puddles after rain or winter thaw, overgrown forestry/skidder-path sections in summer, natural-water uncertainty, and nearby Stage 13 bark-beetle/dead-spruce hazards.

facilities.name: Nykvarn trail start
facilities.description: Official stage start about 100 m west of Nykvarn station, near Maskinförarvägen/Holländarvägen.

facilities.name: Nykvarn station
facilities.description: Rail/bus access near the trail start. Mälartåg/regional rail and SL/Sörmlandstrafiken context should be checked live before travel.

facilities.name: ICA Supermarket Nykvarn
facilities.description: Food/resupply near the station and start; shop opening hours apply.

facilities.name: Nykvarn centrum cafe/food
facilities.description: Additional start-area food/cafe context from map research; opening hours change.

facilities.name: Nykvarn centrum parking
facilities.description: Officially listed parking context near Nykvarn centrum/start. Nykvarn kommun lists central/commuter parking but says there is currently no municipal long-term parking; check signs and do not assume multi-day use.

facilities.name: Turinge Hotel off-route lodging
facilities.description: Off-route lodging/restaurant context north/east of the Nykvarn start. Useful pre/post hike, not a trail facility.

facilities.name: Vidbynäs Gård off-route lodging
facilities.description: Off-route lodging/conference/restaurant option farther north of Nykvarn centre; treat as a detour service.

facilities.name: Jägarskogen parking
facilities.description: Officially listed parking/access option for the reserve and northern Yngern area.

facilities.name: Jägarskogen reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules include no tenting, no caravans/campers, dogs leashed, fires only at prepared places, riding only where marked, and no damage to living or dead wood.

facilities.name: Jägarskogsudden shelter
facilities.description: Wind shelter/rest context in Jägarskogen reserve, about 1 km off the connector; shelter source notes fireplace/firewood/bin context, but reserve rules apply and tenting is prohibited.

facilities.name: Jägarskogen prepared firepit
facilities.description: Prepared fire place in/near Jägarskogen reserve; side facility, not a general fire permission or campsite. Check current fire bans.

facilities.name: Sandtorp bus stop context
facilities.description: Nearby bus-stop context from OSM around Sandtorp/Sandtorpsbadet; check live SL/Sörmlandstrafiken before relying on service.

facilities.name: Sandtorpsbadet tent/bathing area
facilities.description: Officially suitable tent place after about 6 km, with bathing/natural-water context. Treat as low-service and verify local signs/current permission before camping because local order rules generally restrict camping on bathing places; no confirmed public toilet, tap, kiosk, or fireplace.

facilities.name: Sandtorpsbadet camping/fire caveat
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden lists Sandtorpsbadet as suitable for tenting, but Nykvarn local rules generally restrict camping and fires at bathing beaches. Sandtorpsbadet is not listed among the maintained municipal beaches checked in this pass, so rely on posted signs and keep tents/fire off beach-use areas unless clearly permitted.

facilities.name: Sandtorpsbadet / Yngern water
facilities.description: Bathing/lake water only; Sörmlandsleden gives no drinking-water guarantee for Yngern.

facilities.name: Early wayfinding caution
facilities.description: Hiker reports describe missed turns near the Nykvarn/Jägarskogen side despite markings. Use current official map/GPX and do not rely on the incomplete OSM relation alone near the start.

facilities.name: Vargberget viewpoint
facilities.description: Approximate route note: official text says the connector climbs Vargberget with views toward Nykvarn/Yngern.

facilities.name: Wet/overgrown section caution
facilities.description: Trip reports mention wet puddles after wet seasons and overgrown forestry/skidder-path footing in places. Waterproof footwear and current navigation help after rain, thaw, or late-summer growth.

facilities.name: Källsvik 30 tap
facilities.description: Official year-round tap outside the carport; strongest refill on this connector. Trail-listed and high-confidence, but private-property-adjacent: use only the listed tap, be quiet, do not camp/cook/wash, leave no trash, block no driveway, and do not enter yards or buildings.

facilities.name: Källsvik private-property etiquette
facilities.description: The official tap is on the outside of a private carport. Treat it as a quick refill only: no lingering, camping, cooking, washing, trash, driveway blocking, or entry into private areas.

facilities.name: Anderså / Ånderså tent-rest area
facilities.description: Officially suitable tent/rest place between Yngern and Gullsmorasjön; OSM also maps a backcountry campsite here.

facilities.name: Yngern-Gullsmorasjön bridge rest
facilities.description: Officially noted pleasant rest area at the passage between Yngern and Gullsmorasjön; lake water is natural surface water only.

facilities.name: Yngern fishing permit required
facilities.description: Fishing on Yngern requires appropriate permit coverage, and Gullsmorasjön fishing rights were not verified in this pass. Check current local fishing rights before fishing.

facilities.name: Spring north of Djupsjön
facilities.description: Official natural spring about 800 m north of Djupsjön; OSM also maps a spring at nearly the same point. Treat/filter and field-check flow, especially in dry periods.

facilities.name: Etapp 13 / 13:2 join
facilities.description: Exact connector join to Stage 13 from OSM node 2819394364, west/southwest of the Djupsjön shelter/service node. Keep separate from the nearby 13:1 join and shelter marker so branches do not visually collapse together.

facilities.name: Djupsjön shelter/service node
facilities.description: Nearby main-stage service node with shelter, fireplace, tent context, swimming, and unknown-quality natural water; useful continuation/overnight context for 13:1/13:2.

facilities.name: Djupsjön shelter firepit
facilities.description: Prepared firepit at/near the Djupsjön shelter; bring your own fuel where allowed and check current fire bans.

facilities.name: Djupsjön dry toilet near junction
facilities.description: OSM-derived dry toilet near the main-route junction/service area; one mapped toilet here is tagged drinking_water=no. Verify exact closest toilet in the field.

facilities.name: Djupsjön east dry toilet
facilities.description: Additional OSM-derived toilet east of the shelter/service node; useful for endpoint context but field verification is recommended.

facilities.name: Stage 13 dead-spruce hazard
facilities.description: Adjacent Stage 13/Holmsjöskogen-Stora Envättern context has official bark-beetle/dead-spruce fall-risk warnings, especially in wind or storms.
